guides.title: Best Time to Visit
guides.description: Discover the best seasons and months to explore different parts of India.
guides.intro: India has different climates across its regions, so the best time to visit depends on the destination and the experience you want.

sections.title: Winter Season
sections.content: October to February is a comfortable time to explore many parts of India.

sections.title: Summer Season
sections.content: March to June can be hot in many regions. Hill stations are good choices during this season.

sections.title: Monsoon Season
sections.content: July to September brings rainfall to many parts of India. Kerala, Goa and the Western Ghats are beautiful during this season.

guides.tip: Check the local weather before planning your trip.

guides.title: Budget Travel
guides.description: Plan your Indian trip with smart budgeting tips for accommodation, food and transport.
guides.intro: India offers travel options for different budgets. With proper planning, you can enjoy great destinations without spending too much.

sections.title: Affordable Accommodation
sections.content: Hostels, guesthouses, homestays and budget hotels can help reduce accommodation expenses.

sections.title: Public Transport
sections.content: Trains, buses and metro services are affordable options for travelling between cities.

sections.title: Local Food
sections.content: Local restaurants and regional food provide delicious meals at affordable prices.

guides.tip: Create a daily budget and keep some extra money for emergencies.

guides.title: Getting Around
guides.description: Learn about trains, buses, flights, taxis and other ways to travel across India.
guides.intro: India has a large transportation network that makes travelling between cities, states and destinations easier.

sections.title: Trains
sections.content: Indian Railways connects major cities, towns and many tourist destinations.

sections.title: Buses
sections.content: Government and private buses are useful for travelling between nearby cities and towns.

sections.title: Flights
sections.content: Domestic flights are useful when travelling long distances and when you want to save time.

guides.tip: Book trains and flights early during holidays and peak travel seasons.

guides.title: Packing Guide
guides.description: Know what to pack for different destinations, seasons and types of travel.
guides.intro: A good packing plan makes your journey more comfortable. Your packing list should depend on the destination and weather.

sections.title: Clothing
sections.content: Pack comfortable clothes according to the weather and destination.

sections.title: Travel Essentials
sections.content: Keep your ID, tickets, medicines, chargers, power bank and toiletries with you.

sections.title: Destination Specific Items
sections.content: Beach destinations may require sunscreen and swimwear, while mountain destinations may require warm clothes.

guides.tip: Keep important documents and valuables in a safe place.

guides.title: Travel Safety
guides.description: Useful safety tips to help you enjoy a comfortable and secure journey.
guides.intro: Good planning and awareness can make your journey safer and more comfortable.

sections.title: Protect Your Belongings
sections.content: Keep your phone, wallet, passport and valuables secure.

sections.title: Stay Connected
sections.content: Keep your phone charged and share your travel plan with someone you trust.

sections.title: Emergency Preparation
sections.content: Save important emergency numbers and keep copies of important documents.

guides.tip: Stay alert in crowded places and avoid sharing personal information with strangers.

guides.title: Responsible Travel
guides.description: Travel responsibly by respecting local communities, culture and the environment.
guides.intro: Responsible tourism means enjoying destinations while respecting the environment, local communities and cultural heritage.

sections.title: Respect Local Culture
sections.content: Respect local traditions, customs, religious places and dress codes.

sections.title: Reduce Waste
sections.content: Avoid unnecessary plastic, carry reusable items and dispose of waste properly.

sections.title: Support Local Communities
sections.content: Buy local products, eat at local restaurants and support local services.

guides.tip: Leave every destination as clean and beautiful as you found it.
